//: Envelope for the oracle attention driver's chains (chain-oracle-*.json), mounted by `contenox mission fire --oracle`. Two capabilities, both in-process: oracle.submit_verdict (the one model-facing verdict tool; delivery runs through the service layer under the MISSION envelope's own attention bounds) and oracle.verdict_state (the deterministic chain gate). Everything else is denied — deny, not approve, because nobody watches this chain to answer an ask. No shell, no filesystem, no network: the oracle executes nothing and no command/prefix rule exists to be subverted via PATH.

rules.//: The verdict tool. A wait verdict executes nothing; an answer verdict is still bounded by the mission envelope's attention.allowAgentAnswers / maxAgentAnswers, enforced in the service layer.
The deterministic corrective gate — a pure in-process read of the bound contract's state; never advertised to the model.
